newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah volatile in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah volatile in late trading.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was volatile against the dollar in moderate late Wednesday trading.
Dealers said spot rupiah rose to a high of 2,375.75 at midday from 2,382.0 on selling from Singapore operators, before it settled at around 2,378.0/79.0 at 0915 GMT.
They said it was difficult to read where the market was heading, suggesting further volatility until Friday.
"It's a volatile day. Players prefer to be sidelined and enter the market when some big players come in," one said.
The dealer said it was more a muscle play in the market.
